'''Nergon-14''' was a volatile mineral that was used in the construction of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. It was also utilized in commercially available explosives and [[Black market/Legends|black market]] devices.

==Characteristics==
Nergon-14 was a powerful explosive substance, and was used in proton torpedo warheads, as well as a variety of demolition charges. The mineral was mined and was highly unstable in its raw form, to the point that significant physical or energy interaction with the raw mineral would detonate it. Refining the mineral added some stability, at a minor cost to explosive performance. While not as powerful as the [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] used in [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], Nergon-14 was more stable in its refined form and therefore better suited to massive shipboard armament requirements. When inert, its color was blue, changing to red and white before exploding. Nergon-14 could be used in small amounts in conjunction with [[putty]] for [[Safe|safecracking]].

==History==
The mineral was mined extensively on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].

Some years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] known as [[Kleb Zellock]] acquired quantities of Nergon-14 for the Empire on [[Tyne's Horky]]. Members of the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]] used Nergon-14 explosives during their terrorist activities shortly after [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] fell to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

As of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Tynnan/Legends|Tynnan]] demolitions expert [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] carried vials of Nergon-14 among his equipment.

While training undercover at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] ordered twelve Nergon-14 charges from [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]]. Corran intended to destroy a temple of the long dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] by placing the charges at key structural points. However, Kun's vengeful and still very powerful spirit melted the charges in defiance of Corran's attempts.
